name: animate-libs
description: Procedural animation in any style, with vendored JavaScript libraries. Built on cth9191/animate (MIT).

plugins.name: animate-libs
plugins.description: Short procedural animations as single-file canvas videos. Adds nine vendored JavaScript libraries (waapi, gsap, d3, katex, mathjax, lottie, matter, three, glsl) seeked frame by frame, an equation path, and five more styles (chalkboard, blueprint, terminal, flat-vector, kinetic-type). Extends cth9191/animate; the upstream repo is not changed.
